title: Stock lot
description: The member's stock, personal and shared, of one material at one location, quality and stolen state, summed across org-unit pools, with its split into personal stock and each pool. It has no row id.

key.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

split.description: How the lot splits into the member's personal stock and the member's own shared stock in each unit's pool, each in the lot's unit. A pool of a unit the member has left stays while they hold stock in it. Other members' shared stock is never counted. Shared stock outside any unit counts as personal, so personal plus the pools add up to quantity, up to the rounding of each amount.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.
